milestones.why: first like-for-like evidence (same seeds and harness) that paused-simulator benchmarks overstate frontier robot performance: 97% paused vs 50% live

note: RoboLiveMem runs the same robot-memory tasks with the world paused and running: 8 Claude and GPT models drop from 97% to 50% success. Artificial Analysis launched AA-Robotics-Sim (simulated Unitree G1; GPT-6.2 Astra 71.0) and reported GPT-6.2 Astra at 79 on AA-Robotics. Later run: Roboclock charges model thinking time to the task clock, and GPT-6 Astra falls from 19.0% to 3.0% while the fine-tuned π0.5 keeps 8.3%; Xiaomi Robotics' Mibot-RUA (GPT-6 Astra) now tops the RoboDojo agent track at 79.33% SR, starred for task-specific priors.

Same model, new harness: GPT-6.2 Astra scores 97% on RoboDojo-RC Tier 1 through Codex vs 65.7% through Inspect Robots; Robocurve is retiring RoboDojo. From the arXiv scan: Embo-Harness, a controlled harness study, puts a directly-acting GPT-6-Astra at 83.3% on RoboLab-120 (second to AMP1's 86.0%).

milestones.why: first like-for-like evidence that the harness, not the model, moved a real-world leaderboard (97% vs 65.7%, same model, same evaluator)

note: Waddle-1, a robot-use agent directing local lower-level policies, tops Robocurve's RoboDojo-RC Tier 1 at 81.4% vs 65.7% for GPT-6.2 Astra (not like-for-like: no call cap). From the arXiv scan: HuGo has gpt-5.4 write closed-loop policy code over a frozen whole-body controller on a Unitree G1 (93.3% zero-shot on hardware for its best push-button policy).
Anthropic reports Claude Fable 5.2 at 64.9% on RoboDojo Sim in its own runs, more than double GPT-6 Astra (29.8%).
ForceHarness lets frozen frontier models use force without a wrist sensor, lifting GPT-6 Astra from 2/60 to 54/60 on six real contact tasks.
List published with 72 entries; daily automated maintenance switched on.
